title: Model catalog
subtitle: Every model your providers offer, grouped into public aliases. Naming rules and Jev group the same model even when providers spell it differently. Turn a whole model or single providers on and off.
lastRefresh: Last refreshed {when}. Refreshes automatically every {hours, plural, one {hour} other {# hours}}.
neverRefreshed: Not refreshed yet. Refreshes automatically every {hours, plural, one {hour} other {# hours}}.

jev.summary: Jev checked {asked, plural, =0 {no models} one {# model} other {# models}} in the last refresh and grouped {matched, plural, =0 {none} one {# of them} other {# of them}} ({cost}).
jev.pending: {count, plural, one {# model waits} other {# models wait}} for Jev in the next refresh.
jev.missing: Models are grouped by naming rules only. Add a separate OpenRouter key for Jev under <link>Settings</link> to also group models that providers name differently.
jev.error: {code, select, JEV_AUTH {OpenRouter rejected the Jev API key.} JEV_CREDITS {The OpenRouter account for Jev has no credits left.} JEV_RATE_LIMITED {OpenRouter rate-limited the Jev requests.} other {The Jev request failed.}} The remaining models are checked in the next refresh.

failedTitle: Some providers could not be refreshed
failed: {name}: {code, select, UPSTREAM_AUTH {the provider rejected the API key} UPSTREAM_EMPTY {the provider returned no models, the previous list is kept} BASE_URL_REQUIRED {the base URL is missing} other {the request failed}}

filter.label: Show
filter.option: {filter, select, active {Active} fresh {With new providers} missing {Not created} disabled {Turned off} other {All models}}

groupToggle: Turn {alias} on or off for every key
providers: {active} of {total, plural, one {# provider} other {# providers}} active
newProviders: {count, plural, one {# new provider} other {# new providers}}
autoRoutesHint: Providers that start offering this model are routed in the next refresh. Your own OpenAI-compatible servers are always turned on by hand.
source: {source, select, route {Active route} manual {Set by hand} rule {Same name} jev {Jev} other {Own model}}
untrusted: Own server: turn on by hand
assignHint: Pick an existing alias or type a new one. An active route moves along.
empty: Connect a provider, then refresh the catalog to group its models.
readOnly: You can view the catalog. Changes need the models:manage permission.
